content.title: Doom Alert Payoff | Phone Warning, Route Shift and Distant Verification
content.summary: An adult technician travels to verify an orbital-impact warning and calmly drinks at the safe overlook. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original lead, phone and vehicle persist. + A single message redirects the route. + Travel inserts preserve vehicle and destination continuity. + The warning is verified at a non-graphic safe distance. + The calm final action contrasts with the large background event.
quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult observatory technician finishes one sandwich outside an unbranded roadside cafe beside a graphite coupe. He looks once from phone to sky, enters the coupe and follows one empty coastal highway. Keep the technician safely in the foreground; he raises one iced tea, smiles once and takes one sip.

The warning contains one testable external claim.
The distant event visibly verifies the warning without graphic harm.
The final mundane gesture preserves geographic safety and comic contrast.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用日常用餐建立现实，手机红字给出单一灾难警告；人物驾车转移到海边，远端天体撞击逐步验证信息，他在安全前景完成一口饮品作为反差收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original lead and one phone persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original lead and one phone persist."

invariants.rule: The warning contains one testable external claim.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The warning contains one testable external claim."

invariants.rule: Travel is motivated by the message.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Travel is motivated by the message."

invariants.rule: The distant event visibly verifies the warning without graphic harm.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The distant event visibly verifies the warning without graphic harm."

invariants.rule: The final mundane gesture preserves geographic safety and comic contrast.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final mundane gesture preserves geographic safety and comic contrast."
